Static Architecture Analysis - source facts support comparisons of code organization
|-- [M] Analysis boundary
|   |-- StaticAnalyzer.analyze(request) -> artifact + measurements + compiler mode
|   |   `-- Select repository inputs, views, framework summaries and partition comparisons
|   |-- Extraction implements this contract; depends on domain schema and derivation
|   |   `-- AnalysisContext manages compiler/evidence; Declarations resolves source entities
|   |-- Modular structure combines component boundaries, name visibility and dependencies
|   |   |-- Imports, reexports and JSX composition connect components
|   |   |-- Scope parents and declarations support local lookup before compiler lookup
|   |   `-- Layer/feature metadata supports grouping above source-file organization
|   `-- Evidence limits
|       |-- Persisted schema still separates containment and lexical views
|       `-- Optional exported metadata is not populated by the supplied extraction code
|-- [C] Extract a pinned graph
|   |-- CLI selects TS/TSX inputs -> invokes staticAnalyzer directly with all views
|   |   `-- This path runs independently of the interactive backend
|   |-- Index declarations -> resolve imports -> discover JSX composition
|   |-- Any view beyond containment requested? -> extract lexical references
|   |-- Calls, ownership or dependencies requested? -> initialize resources
|   |   `-- Extract calls -> apply framework summaries
|   |       `-- Ownership or dependencies requested? -> prepare dataflow inputs
|   |           `-- Release compiler -> extract dataflow -> connect callback candidates
|   |-- Finish snapshot -> release working state -> derive results -> return
|   |   `-- [O] Cleanup shown here follows successful extraction; no enclosing finally
|   |-- [O] Compiler state belongs to each AnalysisContext
|   |   |-- Begin with syntax; first checker access enables semantic resolution
|   |   `-- Pin compiler inputs before release; small runs may retain a shared prior program
|   `-- Meaning of extracted relations
|       |-- Call edges describe static targets/candidates, not observed activation ancestry
|       `-- Ownership schema expresses creation, retention, mutation and disposal capabilities
|           `-- Relation vocabulary alone does not establish a complete resource lifetime
|-- Evidence contract: every interpretation remains tied to its inputs
|   |-- Selection bounds analysis; additional imports may be read for resolution
|   |-- Snapshot pins source/configuration hashes, compiler identity and available Git state
|   |-- Facts carry method, status, supporting relations and source ranges
|   |   `-- Range identity: analysis snapshot ID + path + file hash + UTF-16 offsets
|   `-- Recorded uncertainties make affected view coverage partial
|       `-- Timing and memory measurements remain outside deterministic artifact facts
|-- [D] Compare organizations against the same dependency graph
|   |-- Value flow, arguments, returns and state access describe computational dependencies
|   |   `-- These edges exist independently of the partition chosen to group entities
|   |-- deriveAnalysis selects analyzed source entities, excluding structural/type scaffolding
|   |   |-- Resolved/inferred edges form call, data, state and reactive graph layers
|   |   `-- Requested directory, layer or single-group partitions supply memberships
|   |-- Graph layers + memberships -> coverage, edge mass, cohesion and partition comparisons
|   |   `-- Seeded shuffle baselines provide a comparison with rearranged memberships
|   `-- Per-layer cycle condensation preserves relation IDs between components
|       `-- Derivation also produces findings and a containment tree projection
|-- Optional incremental session: reuse facts without reusing an old snapshot
|   |-- IncrementalAnalyzer wraps an injected extractor; the shown CLI bypasses this wrapper
|   |-- Current import resolution + cached dependency edges -> dependency components
|   |   `-- Uncertain global effects broaden invalidation to one combined component
|   |-- Component key includes environment, selected paths, member hashes and resolutions
|   |   |-- Key matches -> reuse fragment
|   |   `-- Key changes -> invoke extractor for that component's selected paths
|   |-- Merge fragments -> fresh snapshot -> recompute derived results
|   `-- [O] Session owns checkpoint; replace it only after complete assembly succeeds
|       |-- Export/restore clone data; restore validates fragments
|       `-- Busy guard rejects concurrent updates; finally clears the guard on failure
|-- Diagram boundary: pinned leaf ranges can supply conceptual group membership
|   |-- joinSourceRange receives diagram revision ID, leaf ID and an analysis-pinned range
|   |   |-- Snapshot/path/hash mismatch -> stale, no entities; no silent rebasing
|   |   `-- Matching pin -> validate offsets -> containment/intersection match
|   |       `-- Eligible entities found -> matched; otherwise -> unmapped
|   |-- partitionFromSourceJoins uses matched joins for the requested diagram revision
|   |   `-- Preserve overlaps; sorted group ID chooses primary; uncovered entities have none
|   `-- These helpers are separate entry points; the shown CLI supplies no diagram joins
`-- CLI publication: completed artifact -> compressed artifact, report and run manifest
    |-- Canonical chunks -> gzip -> temporary artifact -> rename; finally removes temporary path
    |-- Report and manifest publish through their own temporary-file renames
    `-- Manifest links analysis snapshot ID to byte hashes, coverage and run measurements
